image_description: A close-up photograph of a Brown Pelican perched on a wooden piling. The bird is resting with its head tucked back against its body, showcasing its long bill, distinctive gular pouch, and brownish-grey plumage with darker flight feathers. The background is a solid, out-of-focus grey sky.
